extraction.placeName: Rummelsburg (Stadion, Sparta Lichtenberg vs. BFC Dynamo)
extraction.summaryEn: Fans of BFC Dynamo set off pyrotechnics outside the stadium and attacked police with bottles, firecrackers and punches during a football match, injuring a child, a steward and twelve officers. Two cases of Nazi salute display and one of insulting police were also recorded, plus a separate group chanting unconstitutional slogans in a pub on Weitlingstraße.
